notes: South China was ruled by the Southern Qi (479–502), not the Jin.
The Alchon Huns (Toramana) ruled the Punjab c. 500.
The Western Roman Empire ended in 476.
Added the Hephthalite Empire in Bactria and Sogdia.
Filled unclaimed land with peoples and cultures from neighbouring maps.
Named the remaining unclaimed regions after their regional peoples.
The Chavín culture ended about 200 BCE; the highlands are the Recuay culture.
The Chorrera culture ended about 300 BCE; Ecuador is the regional cultures that followed it.
